bottoms.width: within C's base-shorts outline ± 3 between W and W + 54

waist/hip.bodyAndShadow: no body under C's base garments — a bare midriff (crop top) is outside v1; no shadow from one item onto another in either picture; a skin shadow only on C's skin (D-214)

sleeve/wrist.order: sleeves over C's arms; C's hand is the base's (FIT-3 protect)

bottoms.full: hem bottom in A + [6, 12], square, at least C's leg ± 10 wide from A − 30 down to the hem

trousers/shoes.bodyAndShadow: the ankle above a shoe under cropped bottoms is C's (intended); no shadow from the hem onto the shoe in either picture

modelDraws.top: Replace the figure's grey base top completely — no grey left anywhere, also not at the lower side corners at the hips. Either end the hem exactly where the grey base top ends, or as a straight hip-length hem one third to one hand-width below it, the same distance across the whole width, and then at least a finger wider than the shorts at the hips. Long sleeves end just above the wrist and never touch the hand. No shadow on the trousers.
modelDraws.bottoms: Start exactly where the grey base top ends and draw nothing above it. Keep any waistband seam or belt within a finger-width of the top edge; no other horizontal line across the hips. At the hips stay as wide as the grey base shorts. Either end clearly above the ankle (shorts, skirts, capri: the leg shows above any shoe), or end just below the ankle with a straight, square hem that is wider than the leg on both sides.
modelDraws.shoes: Cover the foot up to at least the ankle. A boot shaft may go up to about one hand-width above the ankle, not higher, and stays close to the leg (no flared shaft). No shadow from trousers on the shoe.
